records.text: The European Commission forced Romania to remove its online-gambling restrictions in 2010.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So essentially what happens next is the EU Commission gets involved and the EU Commission says, oh, actually it doesn't work for us. This is in 2009. ... And we want to edit this and allow online gambling. We still want online gambling to happen. I want you to keep in mind in 2009. ... actually set up a base. So now we are in 2010 and the EU forces that online gambling restrictions are removed as well.

verification.notes: Romania amended its framework in 2010 to expressly regulate and license remote gambling, but current EU and Romanian legal sources do not support the stronger claim that the European Commission forced Romania to remove online-gambling restrictions; licensing restrictions remained.

sources.title: Romania Law No. 246/2010 amending gambling regulation
sources.relevance: Primary text showing 2010 remote-gambling licensing rather than removal of all restrictions.

sources.title: European Commission: Online gambling
sources.relevance: Explains that member states retain distinct national regulatory frameworks.
